We investigate the effects of LLMs on research productivity, reproducibility, and funding allocation. Our findings suggest that LLMs can enhance research productivity and accelerate data analysis, but may compromise reproducibility and lead to biased results. We recommend that researchers carefully consider the limitations and potential biases of LLMs when using them in their research.
